technique_cue_conflicts_resolved.resolution: No conflict possible: F1 and F4 offer no panel crops (tiers C2_order_violation and C3_caption_swap), so these nodes carry figs F1/F4 with panel_ids [] and are not cue-checked. merged_nodes: F6c (centre-of-mass distance) and F6d (interaction energy) merged into one OBS o10: both panels are xy_curve and state the same claim, that the flat surface plateaus after about 6 ns while the spiky one does not.
F8d (CD31 expression) and F8e (vessel count) merged into one OBS o22: same modality, same ranking claim over the same five groups.
F4b,c (OD600 growth curves) folded into o14's image_note rather than a separate node: the ranking is the same claim as the F4a colony counts.

F5b 'Bacterial capture' and F5c 'Bacterial capture' were kept apart (o12 membrane destruction from TEM sections; o11 particle-bacterium proximity from SEM fields) because they state different claims, but the duplicate 'spikes penetrate the cytomembrane' reading was folded into o12's image_note with image_support partial.

The wound-photograph reading (F7c, o17) and the wound-size curve (F7b, o16) were kept apart (different modality) but both evidence the single PRF node s16; the day-4 scab stage is in o17's image_note only.
'Cu(II) catalyses H2O2' and 'MoO3 accelerates it' merged into the single PRP node s11; the cascade mechanism that separates them sits in s12.

F1 morphology (o1) and F1 EDX (o2, o3) were split rather than merged because micrograph and spatial_map are different modalities; the Si-rim claim (s9) and the Cu/Mo-core claim (s10) are separate structure nodes.
'no live bacterium in V-POD-M+H2O2' (F4d) and 'zero colonies' (F4a) kept apart as o13 (localisation, evidences s14) and o14 (count, evidences s15).
